additional_info.subject: ID0380095-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2 / S6 313740137001] DC3 and DC4 CableTempSensor CRM:00797001252
additional_info.body:
Dear Daniel,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Sominath
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Y2 / S6 313740137001
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
TpzGGB
Problem Description
: DC3 and DC4 CableTempSensor
Troubleshooting
:
Upon reviewing the logs, we have detected anomalies related to the CableTempSensor error of the DC3 and DC4 cable.
This error has recurred multiple times over the past 4 weeks. Therefore, we suggest examining the cable temperature sensor of outlet DC3 & DC4 and, if necessary, replacing the cable. (please carry spare with you)
Please refer to the attached snapshot of the continuous error occurrences for the past 4 weeks.
Kindly follow the steps below to troubleshoot the fault leading to these error flags:
Step 1: Turn off the power supply to the charger.
Step 2: Identify the cables P1, P2, N1, and N2 associated with Pt1000. Refer to the picture below for your reference.
Step 3: Check the ambient temperature and note it. Then, using a multimeter, measure the resistance of P1, P2, N1, and N2.
Step 4: Click on the following link to see the resistance table of Pt 1000 pertaining to the temperature and its corresponding resistance: Pt1000 Resistance Table
https://www.sterlingsensors.co.uk/pt1000-resistance-table
DC3 CABLE:
DC4 CABLE:
Also please refer to the below knowledge article to check the cable sensor:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101 and EVSE_TempLowerLimit_ low temperature - Dynamics 365
,,
Note -: KA applicable to DC3 and DC4 as well (
EcoG KF211 and KF212.
).
For the Error Flag "
MCB_FC2-3_DispenserSupply"
means, seems MCB FC2 or FC3 is tripped, t
hese fuses are used to provide 230V to dispenser.
If you have any questions or need assistance with something, feel free to let me know.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0380095
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sominath Nagalgaon
